input:
Scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：孟子和妈妈搬家了，Within the same clause, the second repeated name should be omitted because “妈妈” clearly refers to Mengzi’s mother. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
Run 2: Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：孟子和他的妈妈搬家了，his mother was mentioned in the immediately preceding sentence, so a pronoun is more natural for this close re-occurrence; 的 also marks the possessive relationship. [rule: none]
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：孟子和妈妈搬家了，The mother was just mentioned, so use the close re-occurrence form instead of repeating Mengzi’s name inside the same noun phrase. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]

output.reason: All runs address the repeated reference to 孟子’s mother, but their rewrites retain the redundant subject instead of making the teacher’s intended deletion.
